notes.title: Major Update: Teddy v. Elon
notes.content:
NEW BOSS
The White House has been taken over by DOGE. Do you have what it takes to take down Elon and his cronies?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/0ed4ef46c539a2e72086a7c788576c7a1926aacb.png"]

Elon can be fought on any round – but beware, you may need to hone your skills before standing a chance against the world's richest man. Those who succeed will be handsomely rewarded. 
NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER
Teddy Roosevelt joins the roster as a playable character!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/d0fb3863c36d4c11ca9615abbf5160e5010ccb05.png"]

Thank you to everyone who voted in the latest poll, which strongly indicated that the people wanted a new character. Unfortunately for Nixon-bros, it was not Nixon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/22e185fcb2dfdfa33731f0453889b2f9567d4e24.png"]
FOUR PLAYER LOBBIES
Due to popular demand, the game now supports up to four players in a lobby. To enable this, Abraham Lincoln has been emancipated – he is now free. Just in time for Juneteenth.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/f7f78cf25bc508ecd7f067882ced79fae73fcd33.png"]
NEW ADVANCED ENEMIES
As the game goes on, you may notice weak enemies being replaced by more powerful, smarter enemies. This will significantly increase the difficulty of higher rounds. You'll have to use your brain now instead of just jumping around in circles!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/ceb61b5789433862141bdc88c0d6a288d790a321.png"]
CHARACTER LEVELS
You can now level up your character by receiving XP at the end of games. At level 5, you have reached the maximum "golden" level for that character, and you'll unlock their golden skin

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44959610/7debf5ac7ee03b78587b45436198013713ba15cc.png"]
OTHER CHANGES[olist]
The Oval Office door now heals some health at the start of every round.

Characters in the lobby will no longer be lifeless husks. They will now blurt out annoying voicelines while waiting.

Greenbacks can now be used to purchase some skins. Every character now has an On the Money skin which is meant for players who have leftover Greenbacks but nothing to purchase. Additionally, the Pho-bama and Plump skins are purchase-able for a small amount. 

Trump rework - Our statistics show that Trump is the bigliest character. At the same time, he felt clunky to play in some ways. As a compromise, Trump has been nerfed in exchange for some quality of life changes.

Nerfed "a small loan" from $5000 → $3000

Slight damage nerfs to COVID-19

Decreased maximum number of walls from 6 → 4

Trump's AR-15 now fires in three-round bursts

Trump's MAGA meter now accumulates with weapon accuracy rather than weapon damage. This makes his ultimate easier to accumulate in the early game, but harder to accumulate in the late game.

Overall nerf to dollar drops - enemies will drop 16% less dollars 

New icons for deployables - no more disgusting icons made in Microsoft Paint!

New achievements
[/olist]

A Note on Future Development
Unfortunately, this will likely be the last major patch for this game because other projects have caught my attention.



I will forever be grateful to those that enjoyed the game and provided feedback. This was my first ever multiplayer game, so I am thankful that it got some attention and didn't die as soon as it was published. I really enjoyed developing it, but dwelling on it when other ideas are floating in my head is a waste of time. Maybe the presidents will return one day in a future spinoff :D



Thanks for everything. As always, feel free to hop in our official discord to report bugs, suggest small changes, or chat with other players:

https://discord.com/invite/qcwUmEsHKv

notes.title: Major Update: JFK
notes.content:
NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER
John F. Kennedy joins the roster as a playable character!

https://i.imgur.com/JOhvHfB.png

We love democracy, don't we folks? Kennedy was chosen because of the results of the recent character poll, shown below. A new poll is available now!

https://i.imgur.com/qc7qk3b.png

OTHER CHANGES
[olist]
 Difficulty settings - earn a higher payout for harder games
 Skins - Biden is the benefactor of the first ever skin - Godfrey G. Golden, free for anyone who owns Biden
https://i.imgur.com/ELVvoE5.png
 Biden rework - As a farewell gift to Biden, his weapon has changed to deal explosive burst damage, infecting all enemies with vaccination. This will make him feel less clunky and more impactful
 Pausing - Solo players can now pause the game
 Jimmy Carter - A tribute to Jimmy has been added
 New achievements
[/olist]

BUG FIXES

 The "Kim Gone Un" achievement is no longer attainable by using the nuke button to kill Kim Jong Un.
 Introduced pathfinding improvements on aliens to evenly split between paths into the rose garden
 Obama's explosive ammo now scales with ammo capacity


Join our official Discord with any suggestions and feedback!
https://discord.com/invite/qcwUmEsHKv
